title: Door-Open Overnight Exception Watch
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wandering:alert
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| where hour<"06"
| stats count as overnight_alerts by resident door_name
| sort - overnight_alerts
description: Finds residents and doors associated with frequent overnight exit or wandering alerts.
value: Night-time door activity can be an important safety signal that deserves structured review rather than guesswork.
implementation: Capture `wandering:alert` events with door and resident fields; count overnight alerts before 06:00.
visualization: Table of residents and doors with overnight alert counts.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which doors are involved when overnight wandering or exit alerts keep happening.
